items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer

editorial.brief: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer was the only topic to appear on two feeds at once, Steam and YouTube. Tom Skerritt led Wikipedia with 406,636 views, 1.5 times the next page, and nothing else in the snapshot says why. The USGS logged an M6.9 quake near Vanuatu.
editorial.cover_sub: Tom Skerritt drew 406,636 views, ahead of a Clayface film page and a Jailer 2 page, on a day when the rest of the snapshot offered him no obvious companion story.
editorial.wiki_deck: Tom Skerritt took the top spot on Wikipedia with 406,636 views. Second place, the Clayface film, managed 264,281, and the data offers no reason for the gap.
editorial.letter_headline: A scattered Saturday, one trailer in common
editorial.discourse_deck: Hacker News is curious about a new Kimi model and a map-minded Wikipedia. Lemmy is nostalgic and wary of AI, Bluesky political and sporting, Mastodon fond of sleeping sea otters.
editorial.foreign_deck: The wire ran on AI and jobs, from a US STEM spending pledge to Indian graduates, while searches went to Warriors versus Grizzlies and the British weather.
editorial.markets_deck: Politics and policy dominate: a Fed hold at 94%, a Russia-Ukraine meeting at 100%, a NATO clash at 3%, and Brazil's election at 79% for Flávio Bolsonaro.
editorial.watch_deck: Counter-Strike 2 holds Steam's top 24-hour peak at 1,274,983 players, ahead of Dota 2 at 987,282 and PUBG at 809,926. On Twitch, TheBurntPeanut has 47,990 viewers, double xQc's 23,578.
editorial.yt_note: LISA's Tarantino leads with 44,334,159 views, about eight times ATEEZ's Drip at 5,508,157. A Minecraft Cold War simulation and two trailers fill out the rest of the list.
editorial.closing_note: Gone by tomorrow: Tom Skerritt's 406,636 views, the Warriors versus Grizzlies searches, and the shared billing of the Grand Theft Auto VI trailer. The M6.9 near Vanuatu will be a line in an archive. The sea otters, presumably, will still be holding hands.
wiki_paras: Tom Skerritt was the most-read page on Wikipedia in the latest daily count, with 406,636 views. The Clayface film followed at 264,281, then Jailer 2 at 192,717. The lead over second place works out to 1.5 times, a comfortable margin but not a landslide.

Nothing else in the snapshot explains him. No news item, trend or cluster names Tom Skerritt. The nearest thing is a Mastodon user watching Alien (1979), and nothing in the data connects the two. Readers arrived for reasons the feeds did not record.

Elizabeth Holmes, at 170,289 views, and ChatGPT, at 136,176, complete the top five. Even the fifth page drew more than a hundred thousand readers. Wikipedia's day was broad, descending in steady steps below the leader, with one name clear of the rest.
